---
Test
---
!1 Workflow with Mandatory Unit Tests (!-BuildAndRun-!)

!2 1. Setup Environment
|script                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
|Ensure Dpt Run In Ai Mode|${DELPHI_VERSION} !-AiSession-! Start                           |With Data                                                                                                                                                    |!-WorkflowWithUnitTests-!                                                                                                                                                   |
|pop fixture                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
|# Create Code and Projects                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
|ensure                   |run                                                             |cmd.exe /c copy /y "${TEST_DATA_ROOT}\DptWorkflow\SampleUnit.valid.pas" !-MyCode.pas-!                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|ensure                   |run                                                             |!-powershell -Command "(Get-Content MyCode.pas) -replace 'SampleUnit', 'MyCode' | Set-Content MyCode.pas -Encoding UTF8"-!                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
|ensure                   |run                                                             |!-cmd.exe /c echo ^<Project xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/developer/msbuild/2003"^>^<ItemGroup^>^<DCCReference Include="MyCode.pas"/^>^</ItemGroup^>^<Target Name="Build" /^>^</Project^> > App.dproj-!|
|ensure                   |run                                                             |!-cmd.exe /c echo ^<Project xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/developer/msbuild/2003"^>^<PropertyGroup^>^<DCC_ExeOutput^>.^</DCC_ExeOutput^>^<SanitizedProjectName^>Test^</SanitizedProjectName^>^</PropertyGroup^>^<ItemGroup^>^<DCCReference Include="MyCode.pas"/^>^</ItemGroup^>^<Target Name="Build" /^>^</Project^> > Test.dproj-!|
|# Fake the Test Executable (Test.exe = DPT.exe)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
|ensure                   |run                                                             |cmd.exe /c copy /y "${WDDT_ROOT}\Projects\DPT\DPT.exe" Test.exe                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
|# Register files                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
|Ensure Dpt Run In Ai Mode|${DELPHI_VERSION} !-AiSession-! !-RegisterFiles-! !-MyCode.pas-!|With Data                                                                                                                                                    |!-WorkflowWithUnitTests-!                                                                                                                                                   |

!2 2. Build 'App' fails (Lint missing)
|script                                                                                             |
|Reject Dpt Run In Ai Mode|${DELPHI_VERSION} Build !-App.dproj-!|With Data|!-WorkflowWithUnitTests-!|
|pop fixture                                                                                        |
|check                    |last exit code                       |13                                 |
|ensure                   |output contains                      |Linting required                   |

!2 3. Lint passes
|script                                                                                                                                                  |
|Ensure Dpt Run In Ai Mode|${DELPHI_VERSION} Lint "${WDDT_ROOT}\Projects\DPT\Lint\TaifunUnitStyle.pas" !-MyCode.pas-!|With Data|!-WorkflowWithUnitTests-!|
|pop fixture                                                                                                                                             |
|show                     |last output                                                                                                                   |

!2 4. Build 'App' fails (Tests missing/not run)
|script                                                                                             |
|Reject Dpt Run In Ai Mode|${DELPHI_VERSION} Build !-App.dproj-!|With Data|!-WorkflowWithUnitTests-!|
|pop fixture                                                                                        |
|check                    |last exit code                       |14                                 |
|ensure                   |output contains                      |Unit Tests required                |

!2 5. Run 'Test.dproj' -> Fails (Simulated exit != 0 using invalid arg)
|script                                                                                                                              |
|# Run DPT with invalid command -> Exit != 0                                                                                         |
|Reject Dpt Run In Ai Mode|${DELPHI_VERSION} !-BuildAndRun-! !-Test.dproj-! -- !-InvalidCommand-!|With Data|!-WorkflowWithUnitTests-!|
|pop fixture                                                                                                                         |
|check                    |last exit code                                                        |1                                  |

!2 6. Build 'App' STILL fails (Tests failed)
|script                                                                                             |
|Reject Dpt Run In Ai Mode|${DELPHI_VERSION} Build !-App.dproj-!|With Data|!-WorkflowWithUnitTests-!|
|pop fixture                                                                                        |
|check                    |last exit code                       |14                                 |

!2 7. Run 'Test.dproj' -> Success (Simulated exit 0 using Help)
|script                                                                                                                |
|# Run DPT Help -> Exit 0                                                                                              |
|Ensure Dpt Run In Ai Mode|${DELPHI_VERSION} !-BuildAndRun-! !-Test.dproj-! -- Help|With Data|!-WorkflowWithUnitTests-!|
|pop fixture                                                                                                           |
|check                    |last exit code                                          |0                                  |

!2 8. Build 'App' Success
|script                                                                                             |
|Ensure Dpt Run In Ai Mode|${DELPHI_VERSION} Build !-App.dproj-!|With Data|!-WorkflowWithUnitTests-!|
|pop fixture                                                                                        |
|ensure                   |output contains                      |Build successful                   |
|show                     |last output                                                              |

!2 9. Modify Code -> Build Fails (Needs Lint, then Test)
|script                                                                                                                                                  |
|ensure                   |run                                                                                       |cmd.exe /c copy /y "${TEST_DATA_ROOT}\DptWorkflow\SampleUnit.valid.pas" !-MyCode.pas-! & copy /b !-MyCode.pas-! +,,|
|ensure                   |run                                                                                       |!-powershell -Command "(Get-Content MyCode.pas) -replace 'SampleUnit', 'MyCode' | Set-Content MyCode.pas -Encoding UTF8"-!|
|# First Guard: Lint                                                                                                                                     |
|Reject Dpt Run In Ai Mode|${DELPHI_VERSION} Build !-App.dproj-!                                                     |With Data|!-WorkflowWithUnitTests-!|
|pop fixture                                                                                                                                             |
|check                    |last exit code                                                                            |13                                 |
|# Fix Lint                                                                                                                                              |
|Ensure Dpt Run In Ai Mode|${DELPHI_VERSION} Lint "${WDDT_ROOT}\Projects\DPT\Lint\TaifunUnitStyle.pas" !-MyCode.pas-!|With Data|!-WorkflowWithUnitTests-!|
|# Second Guard: Test (because Code changed > Last Run Time)                                                                                             |
|Reject Dpt Run In Ai Mode|${DELPHI_VERSION} Build !-App.dproj-!                                                     |With Data|!-WorkflowWithUnitTests-!|
|pop fixture                                                                                                                                             |
|check                    |last exit code                                                                            |14                                 |
|# Run Test                                                                                                                                              |
|Ensure Dpt Run In Ai Mode|${DELPHI_VERSION} !-BuildAndRun-! !-Test.dproj-! -- Help                                  |With Data|!-WorkflowWithUnitTests-!|
|# Build                                                                                                                                                 |
|Ensure Dpt Run In Ai Mode|${DELPHI_VERSION} Build !-App.dproj-!                                                     |With Data|!-WorkflowWithUnitTests-!|


!2 10. Cleanup
|script                                                                                            |
|Ensure Dpt Run In Ai Mode|${DELPHI_VERSION} !-AiSession-! Stop|With Data|!-WorkflowWithUnitTests-!|
